rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a rose plant or its flower.

example.english: I bought a rose plant for home, and it looked beautiful when it bloomed.
example.traditional: 我買咗盆玫瑰返屋企，開花嗰陣好靚。
example.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 pun4 mui4 gwai3 faan1 uk1 kei2 hoi1 faa1 go2 zan6 hou2 leng3

rows.note: Use this specifically for the purplish-pink or rose-red color.

example.english: The rose color of this shirt really suits you.
example.traditional: 呢件衫嘅玫瑰紅好襯你。
example.jyutping: ni1 gin6 saam1 ge3 mui4 gwai3 hung4 hou2 can3 nei5
